exceptions.name: synthetic-already-aborted-tls-connect
exceptions.reason: An already-aborted TLS connect never opens. is_open keeps its synthetic SocketState live only until deferred error and close events are delivered; has_opened must remain false so socket.pending stays true.

exceptions.name: turnloop-on-connect-deferred-has-opened
exceptions.reason: on_connect sets is_open with the endpoint addresses, then may start a direct-TLS upgrade that can fail and destroy the socket before 'connect' is emitted. has_opened/connecting are therefore set in a second lock block just before PendingNetEvent::Connect (see the #10465 comment there), so a socket destroyed by a failed upgrade is never recorded as opened.
